summary: Build practical oil and gas M&A skills in valuation, diligence, deal structuring, and integration. Explore the five-day course and enrol.
lede: Oil and gas M&A training covers how to evaluate assets, risks and deal value across acquisitions, divestments and joint ventures. It is designed for corporate development managers, investment analysts, engineers and integration leads who need to assess transaction evidence. Learners practise reserve and production analysis, valuation and sensitivity modelling, and technical, HSE and contract diligence, then map deal risks and prepare a post-close integration plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute to oil and gas acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, and post-close integration. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with financial, technical, commercial, or operational information and need a more integrated transaction perspective.
audience: Oil and Gas Corporate Development Managers
prerequisites: Working knowledge of oil and gas operations, asset economics, corporate finance, commercial contracts, or transaction support is expected. You do not need programming experience. Familiarity with spreadsheet modelling is useful, and advanced tax, legal, reservoir simulation, and accounting matters remain outside implementation depth.
